# Prefix-state fork V88: independent COW caches at exact committed boundaries

Adds `State.forkForPrefix()` for an already materialized committed prefix. Every mutable cache object and MLX Swift context is distinct. Existing KV/raw-indexer/pooled-indexer capacity is initially shared through independent contexts and preserved through MLX copy-on-write; this is COW at allocated-buffer granularity, not a paged attention implementation. Full capacity must be reserved for both branches. GDN FP32 state arrays retain immutable values; convolution/PLE windows and the retained MTP multi row are compacted so a checkpoint cannot pin an entire prefill activation. Draft KV/indexer state and exact offsets are copied too. Recording transactions are rejected.

The fork diagnostic adds exact representation fields beyond ordinary numerical comparisons: completed pooled-indexer rows/count/ratio/base/offset, KV offsets and per-linear-layer n-gram context. Ordinary numerical diagnostics can compare different indexer representations, whereas a state fork must preserve the same one. SHA256 digests of dtype/shape/payload are retained outside comparisons; no diagnostic MLX reader survives across a mutation to artificially force COW. Independent references rebuild the same prefix and explicit append boundaries. Tests diverge sibling branches over the same future rows, grow across capacity boundaries, then mutate the parent and fork descendants; every branch must remain identical to its independent reference, including full continued logits.

All four full-model correctness probes pass:256tokens2949assertions,1023tokens2949,2051tokens3117 (including compressed raw/pooled state), and256tokens with MTP3085, totaling12100. Source prefixes come from the actual generator stopped immediately after completed prefill, with no sampled token consumed or inferred offset. Every MTP committed boundary remains aligned. The harness checks end footprints below10GB between forwards; these are correctness probes with no comparative latency or peak-memory claim. The frozen V88 build and exact commands/outputs are preserved below. This establishes the ownership primitive; reusable-cache retention, eviction/admission charging, serving integration and latency qualification are separate successor work.
